notes.title: Red Bow Released / Fullscreen Mode / Russian Fix
notes.content:
First off, Red Bow has finally released! Just in the nick of time too!

Second, I would encourage everyone to play Red Bow in Windowed mode. The reason behind this is that the steam overlay doesn't like to work properly in full screen but works fine in windowed mode. To access this setting, just run the 'Play Game Setup' when first launching the game. you can also change the window size with the options there to increase or decrease to your liking. 

Thank you to everyone for being so patient and I hope you all enjoy the game :) 

EDIT: I've added a quick patch update to fix the Russian language. It should all work now.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content: Firstly I'd like to apologise to everyone. Red Bow was supposed to release today, but it was knocked back due to the game logo being in the screenshots on the steam store page and it goes against their conditions. I have fixed this problem, but I have to resubmit Red Bow for a new release date. I'm hoping it will only take a few hours and I can release the game today. If not, I will keep you all informed of the new release date, but it shouldn't be too far away.

notes.title: Red Bow Set For The Steam Release January 17th (Multiple Languages Included)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/9b05aab91542d6fe120a74c02c22f610fdd09da2.jpg[/img]

We are very happy to announce the full release of Red Bow!

[h1]Wishlist/Follow on Steam[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/710600/Red_Bow/

[h1]STORY[/h1]
If you were given another chance, would you take it? Or leave it in the hands of a little girl?
Play as Roh, a young girl stuck in a bizarre nightmare of dark and eerie creatures.

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
This short game will have you entangled with its story-driven narrative and puzzles as you help Roh find an answer to her place in this strange world. Red Bow is designed to play and feel as a modern top down Gameboy game with roughly 1 - 2 hours of game play with achievement hunting.

The game uses an RPG top-down style which consists of finding items, secrets and solving puzzles to progress the story. The game progresses in sequences which are filled with secrets and easter eggs! Find the multiple endings by following clues and your gut!
